verdict.rationale: Mercury documents invoicing: manual and automatic invoices, plus an Accounts Receivable API with invoice CRUD, payment-status tracking and webhooks. None of the evidence mentions automatic reminders, dunning or follow-up on overdue invoices. "Automatic invoices" means sending invoices, not chasing late ones, and the API and webhooks are only building blocks a developer could use to construct follow-up, which earns no credit.
